selection_data.mmot: official MMOT train, frozen six-sequence development subset
selection_data.m3ot: official M3OT validation split, four sequences

selection_rule: retain only methods that improve REGR v1 on both MMOT development trackers
retain only methods that improve no refinement on both M3OT development trackers
minimize post-hoc M3OT development false links
break ties by higher MMOT development equal-tracker mean IDF1
evaluation_policy: Run the frozen method once on MMOT test-50 and M3OT held-out. Do not retune after observing those results.
interpretation: MMOT test and M3OT held-out had been exposed by prior REGR work, so these are exploratory retests rather than fresh independent confirmation.
